about: A day given its own title, then the whole series marked free in Google Calendar, a poll, then a day deleted and the notes changed for all events here. Google writes the master's marking into every exception (live probe of 2026-11-16), so the titled day is free at Google as its series is, it does not own its marking, the changes here go through and x-own holds (the regression for #318's case, seed 42701 case 11).
